svg.title: AIX Runner for GitLab
svg.desc: The upstream gitlab-runner v19.5.1, unmodified, plus patches to four dependencies (machineid, moby/term, go-billy, go-git), built with GOOS=aix GOARCH=ppc64. Tested on AIX 7.3 with the shell executor: register, jobs, artifacts, local cache, git clone and cancel.
